decisions.reason: As a close-to-core design extension that remained prominently marketed into 2024, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough and the firm's growth and product-range slack support keeping it.

This product fits the firm's core shower-drainage competence and strategic push toward seamless, barrier-free bathrooms, and its continued dedicated presence suggests satisfactory performance relative to aspirations.

Although the earlier withdrawal of a related pump-assisted line raises the aspiration pressure on this niche, its very recent 2024 launch and strong fit with the firm's existing offer make management likely to give it more time under available organisational slack.
